messages:
maria: Hey infra team — planning to provision a new GPU node pool in asia-west1 for embed-service (steady ~60 qps, mixed short/med context). Thinking through A10G x8 nodes vs H100 x4 nodes. Quotas are limited in the project. Need recommendations on sizing, autoscaler flags, taints/labels, and a safe spot (preemptible) fallback. Any red flags?

aj: A10G usually wins for cost and RAM per GPU for embedding workloads. H100 gives latency wins for large-context gen but costs ~2-3x. What's the p99 SLO?

maria: p99 target ~120ms for typical embed calls, heavier jobs can be async. Cost target is tight; want to keep steady-cost footprint while preserving p99.

sasha: For 60 qps with batching we can pack well on A10G. If you can tolerate slightly higher tail for rare big requests, A10G x8 is sensible. Also check NIC egress bandwidth per machine — some instance types cap throughput and that affects batching throughput.

kai: Quick checklist: GPU quota (GPUs regional), CPU quota, local SSD quota (we sometimes attach for cache), and networking (max pods per node / ENI limits). In asia-west1 we have limited A10G quota right now.

jorge: Pod density math — if we target 4 pods per GPU (safe for memory headroom), 8 GPUs/node -> 32 pods/node. Ensure CNI max-pods is high enough and subnet IP allocation can handle it. If using GKE, set --max-pods-per-node or pick VPC-native with large secondary ranges.

aj: Autoscaler suggestions: prefer fast scale-up and conservative scale-down. Example flags we use: 
```
--expander=least-waste \
--balance-similar-node-groups \
--scale-down-unneeded-time=10m \
--scale-down-delay-after-add=8m \
--max-empty-bulk-delete=1
```
This reduces thrashing and avoids deleting nodes with leftover hot caches.

sasha: For spot/preemptible fallback: create two node pools: "embed-a10g-on-demand" (min 0/desired small) and "embed-a10g-spot" (preemptible / spot, tainted), use podPriority and tolerations so primary pods prefer on-demand but can tolerate spot. Also have a node-taint like `gpu=dedicated:NoSchedule` for dedicated workloads.

maria: Can you paste the gcloud create snippet you'd use?

sasha: Sure — example (adapt to our naming/labels):
```
gcloud container node-pools create embed-a10g-spot \
  --cluster=redwood-infer-asia \
  --region=asia-west1 \
  --machine-type=n2d-standard-32 \
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-a10g,count=8 \
  --num-nodes=0 \
  --min-nodes=0 --max-nodes=10 \
  --preemptible \
  --labels=workload=embed,sku=a10g \
  --node-taints=gpu=spot:NoSchedule \
  --tags=embed-pool
```
And on-demand pool same but without --preemptible and set min-nodes=1.

kai: Note: GKE uses `nvidia-tesla-a10g` or `nvidia-a10g` depending on image. Also add `--accelerator` counts per provider. For H100 the machine types are larger; be careful with GPU-attach limits per zone.

jorge: Quota request template for GCP support (copy + paste):
"We need regional quota increase in asia-west1 for: GPUs (A10G) from X to Y, cpus from X to Y, local SSD GB from X to Y. Project: redwood-infer-prod. Use case: production embedding cluster with up to 8 GPUs per node."

maria: Any network cautions? last time we hit CNI IP exhaustion during a canary.

aj: If you go >100 pods/node you risk CNI limitations. With 32 pods/node you should be fine but ensure the VPC secondary range has capacity: `gcloud compute networks subnets describe <subnet> --region=asia-west1` and check `secondaryIpRanges`. Increase if needed.

sasha: For podPriority: create a PriorityClass `embed-high` with value 1000000 and a preemption policy only if necessary. Also set PDBs for critical head services.

maria: Cost estimate — rough numbers (asia-west1): A10G node (8x) ~ $12/hr vs H100 node (4x) ~ $28/hr (ballpark). With batching we expect lower per-token cost on A10G. We should run a quick perf pilot.

aj: Pilot plan: spin up 2 nodes spot + 1 on-demand, run representative load for 2 hours, capture p99 and token cost. If spot eviction rate > 5% over pilot, reduce reliance on spot.

deploy-bot: autoscaler-alert: scaled up 2 nodes in embed-a10g-spot (reason: cpu request surge) :rocket:

maria: Action items: @kai will file quota support request today (assign). @sasha will create node-pool Terraform plan and autoscaler flags. @aj will prepare perf harness and cost calc. I'll schedule the pilot for tomorrow morning.

sasha: I'll put the TF diff in infra repo and include the `preemptible` pool + taints + priorityclass + documentation on max-pods.

aj: One last reminder — set `--max-surge`/`--max-unavailable` conservatively for rolling upgrades, and enable node auto-repair.

maria: Great, thanks all :thumbsup:
